fixed_source_reason: Cover real failure/diagnostic path; not success-rate estimation or selected favorable case
policy_noise: Independent per depth and candidate arm
cross_policy_check: Fresh diagnostic snapshot copies only actual world params/buffers, keeps newly initialized policy; no optimizer or actual rollout
cross_world_boundary: Reject old thought-path policy importance weighting, allow actual factual sequence likelihood
limits: UNTRAINED architecture/credit connectivity, not efficacy, causal discovery, calibrated confidence, SLEEP improvement, generalization or stable long-horizon importance sampling. Future outcomes are training labels, not final test data.
